$comment: Fragment-safe regex subset of rules/*.md for convention-core's guard engine. validate_rules.py fails if any entry drifts from its rule file or any fragment-safe regex rule is missing.

rules.message: Detached or onAppear Task in a View. Load in the .task { } modifier, which is cancelled with the view; use @concurrent on the callee for work that must leave the main actor. A short Task { await store.save() } inside a button action is fine.
@unchecked Sendable needs a same-line justification: // SAFETY: <how the state is protected>. Prefer an actor, a Mutex or a value type.
Domain is pure: files under Domain/ may import Foundation and nothing else. Move UI code to a view, persistence and networking to the Data layer, and observable state to a Store.
Views must not do networking. Move URLSession or URLRequest work to a repository implementation that the feature's Store calls.
Views call stores, not repositories. Move the call into the feature's Store and read the result from the Store. The word is matched in comments too.

No .shared outside the composition root. Create the dependency in AppDependencies.swift and pass it through an initializer or .environment. A justified Apple singleton needs a same-line // swiftlint:disable:this no_shared_singleton with the reason.
Protocol names take no I- prefix or -Protocol suffix. Name the protocol for its role (UserStore) and the concrete type for how it works (RemoteUserStore).
Hardcoded secret literal. Read it from the Keychain, an uncommitted build configuration or a secrets service, and rotate it if it was ever committed. Non-overridable.
Personal-data field interpolated into a log call. Log a non-personal id instead, or redact with os.Logger privacy: .private. Non-overridable.

No ViewModel types. Put loaded data in a Store per aggregate (@Observable final class), form fields in a Draft struct in the view's @State, and rules in a Domain policy. A screen that coordinates several stores may have a <Screen>Model whose file starts with a comment saying why.

Use @Observable, not ObservableObject. Drop @Published, and hold the object with @State (owner), @Environment (shared) or @Bindable (child) instead of @StateObject, @ObservedObject or @EnvironmentObject.
